description.narrative: The 6th International Conference on Family Planning (ICFP) 2022 in Thailand is a major scientific event that has served as a strategic inflection point for the global reproductive health community since 2009. The conference brings together a network of advocates, researchers and scientists, community and government leaders, health practitioners, economists, civil society members, and young people. ICFP is a movement towards universal access to family planning services, contraception, and other SRHR resources. Moreover, it is a community of advocates, policymakers, young leaders amongst others exchanging ideas and working together to innovate and progress family planning programming, advocacy, and research. The conference will provide a unique opportunity for RESPEKT to engage with Adolescent Sexual Reproductive Health (ASRH) stakeholders from other continents and cultural contexts which will enable project volunteers to share experiences and gain new insights into approaching ASRH.
